conferences.name: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
conferences.emphasis: Broad AI methods and applications, with opportunities for work spanning technical areas.
conferences.fit: For a broadly relevant neurosymbolic or agentic AI advance, supported by strong theory, evaluation or evidence of application impact.
conferences.notes: Main technical track. Camera-ready date has malformed strike-through markup on source; reconfirm before use.

conferences.name: International Conference on Learning Representations
conferences.emphasis: Representation learning, neural models and mechanisms, including neurosymbolic and hybrid AI.
conferences.fit: For a new learning mechanism, neural reasoning architecture, structured representation, or compelling compositional generalisation result.
conferences.notes: Main conference 26–28 Apr; workshops 29–30 Apr. Workshop CFP names San Francisco but contains an erroneous 2026 event year; use official 2027 dates page.

conferences.name: European Semantic Web Conference
conferences.emphasis: Semantic Web foundations, knowledge graphs, semantic technologies and their relationship with AI.
conferences.fit: For evaluated semantic methods or systems, hybrid KG–LLM reasoning, semantic data integration, or research resources and applications.
conferences.notes: Research, Resources and In-Use share this schedule. See Milestones for all published auxiliary tracks.

conferences.name: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
conferences.emphasis: Broad AI research connecting learning, reasoning, planning, agents and applications.
conferences.fit: For a substantial AI method or agent architecture whose contribution extends beyond one ontology, KG task or biomedical setting.
conferences.notes: Same deadlines for AI4Science, AI and Health, AI/Arts/Creativity, and AI for Social Good. Hengqin satellite: 15–17 Aug.

conferences.name: Intelligent Systems for Molecular Biology / European Conference on Computational Biology
conferences.emphasis: Computational methods for biological problems, including biomedical AI, networks, ontologies and knowledge representation.
conferences.fit: For biomedical KGs, ontology-guided discovery or neurosymbolic methods evaluated on biological data. The Bio-Ontologies COSI is especially relevant.
conferences.notes: Rechecked 13 Nov 2026. Proceedings revisions: 18 Mar. Separate talk/poster abstracts: 8 Apr. No date changes found.

conferences.name: International Conference on Machine Learning
conferences.emphasis: Machine learning theory, algorithms, methods and rigorous empirical evaluation.
conferences.fit: For advances in learning, sample efficiency or generalisation that transfer beyond a particular ontology or KG application.
conferences.notes: Expo 31 Jul; tutorials 1 Aug; main conference 2–4 Aug; workshops 5–6 Aug.

conferences.name: International Conference on Automated Deduction
conferences.emphasis: Automated deduction, reasoning procedures, theorem proving and implemented reasoning systems.
conferences.fit: For RustDL or learning-guided deduction when the main advance is a reasoning procedure, proof search strategy or deduction system.
conferences.notes: Workshops 21 and 26 Aug. Use CADE-specific dates, rather than the longer FSCD–CADE umbrella.

conferences.name: International Workshop on Description Logics
conferences.emphasis: Description logic foundations, extensions, reasoning algorithms, systems and applications.
conferences.fit: For specialist feedback on RustDL, ontology reasoning, neural–description-logic integration, or description logic foundations.
conferences.notes: Dates from PC chair Ivan Varzinczak's 9 Nov 2026 announcement; event dates also on dl.kr.org.

conferences.name: European Conference on Artificial Intelligence
conferences.emphasis: General AI research across learning, reasoning, planning, agents and intelligent applications.
conferences.fit: For a substantial AI contribution with relevance across methods or domains, including neurosymbolic systems and biomedical AI.
conferences.notes: Pre-conference 2–3 Oct; main conference 4–7 Oct. Abstract/camera-ready dates and deadline timezone not stated.

conferences.name: International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning
conferences.emphasis: Principles and computational methods for representing knowledge and performing inference.
conferences.fit: For a generalisable reasoning contribution: new semantics, inference algorithms, explanations, or reasoner-constrained neural generation.
conferences.notes: 23/28 Apr are community-reported by KRportal; not confirmed in the accessible official CFP. Workshops 18–20 Sep.

conferences.name: International Conference on Formal Ontology in Information Systems
conferences.emphasis: Ontological foundations, categories, relations and their use in information systems.
conferences.fit: For SULO’s foundational semantics, PRO/SOLID patterns, temporal modelling, or evidence that ontological commitments improve an application.
conferences.notes: IAOA announces joint FOIS/JOWO window; separate programme and submission deadlines not yet found.

conferences.name: Joint Ontology Workshops
conferences.emphasis: Focused ontology communities and interdisciplinary discussion; emphasis varies by workshop.
conferences.fit: For early feedback, collaborators or a focused discussion of ontology–LLM integration, foundational ontology or a domain application.
conferences.notes: Dates are the joint FOIS/JOWO window, not confirmed individual workshop days. Workshop-specific deadlines pending.

conferences.name: International Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning
conferences.emphasis: Integration of neural learning and symbolic representation, inference and problem solving.
conferences.fit: For a new neural–symbolic integration mechanism, training objective, hybrid architecture, or rigorous evaluation of its benefits.
conferences.notes: CFP and submission rounds not announced on association page.

conferences.name: International Conference on Semantic Systems
conferences.emphasis: Semantic technologies, knowledge graphs and AI-enabled semantic systems, including practical applications.
conferences.fit: For applied KG–LLM integration, semantic interoperability or evaluated semantic systems, particularly with practitioner relevance.
conferences.notes: Submission, notification and camera-ready deadlines not yet found.

conferences.name: International Semantic Web Conference
conferences.emphasis: Semantic Web, linked data, ontologies and knowledge graphs, including their integration with AI.
conferences.fit: For ontology-guided KG construction, LLM-to-SPARQL, KG reasoning and learning, semantic interoperability, or a reusable biomedical KG.
conferences.notes: Dates announced by local chair Carolina Cortés. Conference site not retrievable; IMFD confirms Montevideo.

conferences.name: European Conference on Logics in Artificial Intelligence
conferences.emphasis: Logical formalisms, semantics and computational reasoning methods for AI.
conferences.fit: For a new logic-based learning or reasoning method, neural-guided inference, or a substantive formalisation of hybrid AI.
conferences.notes: 2027 co-chair Pedro Cabalar names Bratislava in his university profile. No 2027 CFP or exact dates found.

conferences.name: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
conferences.emphasis: Broad machine learning and AI research, including theory, models, evaluation and interdisciplinary applications.
conferences.fit: For a broadly significant learning method, neurosymbolic mechanism, benchmark or analysis with relevance to the wider ML community.
conferences.notes: Official future-meetings page lists Europe for 2027. No exact dates or submission schedule found.

conferences.name: International Joint Conference on Learning and Reasoning
conferences.emphasis: Integration of logical, relational, statistical and neural learning with reasoning.
conferences.fit: For rule induction, predicate invention, program synthesis, relational learning, or extraction of symbolic knowledge from neural models.
conferences.notes: Latest conference site located is 2026; do not reuse its deadlines.

conferences.name: International Conference on Knowledge Capture
conferences.emphasis: Acquiring, extracting, organising and evaluating knowledge from diverse sources.
conferences.fit: For LLM-to-KG or ontology construction, multimodal knowledge acquisition, human–AI knowledge engineering, or knowledge capture benchmarks.
conferences.notes: Official 2027 page confirms 13–15 Sep at CMU, co-located with NeSy. Calls and submission deadlines forthcoming.

conferences.name: International Conference on Neuro-Symbolic Systems
conferences.emphasis: Design, analysis, synthesis and assurance of dependable neurosymbolic systems.
conferences.fit: For reliable hybrid agents or embodied systems where verification, robustness, formal guarantees or deployment is central.
conferences.notes: Series page lists 2026 and 2025; third-party estimates excluded.

conferences.name: Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence
conferences.emphasis: Learning, knowledge representation and reasoning in the presence of uncertainty.
conferences.fit: For probabilistic neurosymbolic methods or principled reasoning about confidence, uncertainty and incomplete biomedical knowledge.
conferences.notes: AUAI still lists 2026. Estimated February deadlines on trackers excluded.

conferences.name: International Conference on Logic Programming
conferences.emphasis: Logic programming foundations, languages, implementations and applications.
conferences.fit: For neural–logic programming, answer-set-based architectures, probabilistic logic programs, or logic programming contributions to inference.
conferences.notes: ALP conference list has no 2027 entry at check date.

conferences.name: International Joint Conference on Automated Reasoning
conferences.emphasis: Automated and interactive logical reasoning, foundations, implementations and applications.
conferences.fit: For new reasoning procedures, proof-producing systems or learning-guided theorem proving. No separate 2027 edition is currently listed.
conferences.notes: Latest listed edition is IJCAR 2026. Use CADE-31 as the announced 2027 automated-deduction meeting.

conferences.name: Semantic Web Applications and Tools for Healthcare and Life Sciences
conferences.emphasis: Semantic web technologies applied to healthcare and life sciences: ontologies, knowledge graphs, RDF data integration and interoperable tooling, with a strong practitioner and hackathon culture.
conferences.fit: A natural home for SULO, ontology engineering, FAIR life-science data, LLM-to-KG integration and reusable biomedical resources, with a receptive community for students and demos.
conferences.notes: Paper/poster/demo deadline moved from 14 Sep to 30 Sep 2026. Format is historically a tutorial day, two conference days and a hackathon day; the 2027 day-by-day split is not yet published.

conferences.name: Medical Informatics Europe (EFMI MIE 2027)
conferences.emphasis: European health and biomedical informatics: health data spaces, interoperability, information systems, clinical decision support, trustworthy AI and learning health systems.
conferences.fit: For semantic interoperability, health data space infrastructure, ontology-guided clinical data curation or evaluated clinical informatics results aimed at a European health-system audience.
conferences.notes: Paper deadline extended from 20 Oct to 3 Nov 2026. Panels, workshops, tutorials and demos remain open until 26 Jan 2027. No camera-ready date published.

conferences.name: AMIA Amplify Informatics Conference (Informatics Summit + Clinical Informatics Conference)
conferences.emphasis: AMIA's spring meeting: translational bioinformatics, data science, implementation science and applied clinical informatics.
conferences.fit: For translational bioinformatics, biomedical data-science methods or implemented clinical informatics, on a cycle earlier in the year than the Annual Symposium.
conferences.notes: Calls for Summit and Clinical Informatics Conference participation exist but their deadlines were not retrievable at check date.

conferences.name: MEDINFO 2027 — 21st World Congress on Medical and Health Informatics
conferences.emphasis: Global medical and health informatics across research, practice and policy; the biennial IMIA world congress.
conferences.fit: For work with international health-system reach: semantic interoperability standards, FAIR clinical data, knowledge representation for care, or evaluated health AI.
conferences.notes: Official site labels the 31 Jan 2027 deadline as a Friday; 31 Jan 2027 is a Sunday. Reconfirm before relying on it. Notification and camera-ready dates not published.

conferences.name: AMIA Annual Symposium
conferences.emphasis: Biomedical and health informatics in the United States: clinical, translational, public health and data science tracks.
conferences.fit: For clinical knowledge representation, biomedical knowledge graphs, terminology and ontology work evaluated on patient data, or informatics methods with clinical validation.
conferences.notes: Dates and venue (Hilton San Diego Bayfront) from AMIA's own sponsorship listing. Submission schedule for 2027 not yet published; the paper deadline has historically fallen in March.

conferences.name: DBCLS BioHackathon (17th)
conferences.emphasis: Week-long collaborative hackathon on life-science data integration, RDF and semantic standards, and interoperable tooling, run by DBCLS.
conferences.fit: For building and hardening interoperable life-science resources with international collaborators, rather than for a paper; strong fit for SPARQL endpoints, ontology tooling and FAIR infrastructure.
conferences.notes: Listed as the 17th DBCLS BioHackathon in Japan for 2027; dates and city shown as unannounced. The 16th was held in Ehime, 13-19 Sep 2026.
